summary: Internal #tags stay off public archives, chips, sitemap, and RSS; public tags gain per-tag feeds and sitemap URLs.
detailed_changes: Added tags.is_internal (auto from # name prefix) and hide internals from public archives, article chips, sitemap, and tag RSS.
Added /tags/{slug}/rss.xml using a shared RSS feed builder; site-wide /rss.xml unchanged.
Sitemap now lists public tag archive URLs that have published posts.
affected_areas: Page or route: /tags/{slug}, /tags/{slug}/rss.xml, /sitemap.xml, article tag chips
User groups affected: staff tagging posts; public readers of tag archives and feeds
Public impact: new per-tag RSS; internal tags no longer appear publicly
Internal impact: staff can still assign #tags for editorial organisation
